comments.content: `batch.Positions.Ints()` is called inside the `for j` unwind loop, so it re-reads (and potentially syncs/copies) the tensor on every iteration. Hoist `curPositions := batch.Positions.Ints()` outside the `for j := i - 1; ...` loop to avoid redundant tensor reads.

`batch.Positions.Ints()` copies/syncs the entire positions tensor just to read a single element at `Multimodal[...].Index`. Consider caching the result once, since `Ints()` on a synced tensor allocates a new slice each call.
